cc:Work.dc:title: Alloy4Fun native hint benchmark
cc:Work.dc:description: Five methods on 42,388 incorrect inputs. Sequential arms: Alloy Studio/FM24, 16 workers; TAR, 4 workers, 6 GiB cap, 4-CPU quota after host OOM. Unequal resources: descriptive timings and 60s availability, not a speed ranking or isolated latency. Luna excluded.
